resources.string: The \"Aerial\" map layer shows open orthophotos of the German states and Sentinel-2 imagery from your own imagery server (services/imagery-proxy). The map tiles of the visible area are requested from the server; they are cached on the device (up to 200 MB). Switch the layer on in the map layers menu.
The token of this device from scripts/new-token.sh. Leave empty to keep the stored token.
Set up the aerial imagery server first (Settings → Map appearance → Aerial imagery server)
